epistemic_gates.EG-1: EG-1: Geochemical Provenance (ESTABLISHED_BOUNDARY): Oklo Reactor Zones RZ1-RZ16 verified mineral inventory (uraninite, bituminous organic matter, illite, chlorite; Nagy 1991, 1993; Gauthier-Lafaye 1996) has oklo_reactor_zone_biotite_verified = false; biotite is evaluated strictly as an independent comparative 2:1 phyllosilicate and prebiotic-scaffold hypothesis (Hansma 2022), and Robin boundary condition (-D_eff dc/dr = P_eff(c - c_ext)) at cylinder wall r = R in aurascoper/Biofilms is strictly separated from European robin (Erithacus rubecula) avian magnetoreception.
epistemic_gates.EG-2: EG-2: Physical Mechanism (SEPARATE_PHYSICAL_MECHANISMS): Biogenic single-domain Fe3O4 magnetosome chain in magnetotactic bacteria (U_mag / (k_B T) = 5.688616 at 300 K, 5.5051 at 310 K; Crit = Accepted Verified positive code-verification benchmark) vs. inclusion-free paramagnetic biotite K(Mg,Fe)3AlSi3O10(F,OH)2 with (001) cleavage (U_aniso / (k_B T) = 5.894344e-8 at V = 9.8175e-22 m^3 and 6.003953e-5 at V = 1 um^3, B = 50 uT, T = 300 K; Crit = Pruned unless coupled to single-domain Fe3O4 inclusions) vs. cryptochrome-4 [FADdot- ... TrpHdot+] radical-pair spin mixing (f_L = 1.401248 MHz, 1/omega_L = 113.58 ns physical Zeeman timescale, not biological coherence threshold; separated from melanin radiotropism). Includes 3-tier irradiation hierarchy (Park et al. 2004 A508 RPV steel +16% H_c vs. Shong et al. ASTM STP15114S Fe/Ni wire H_c/B_r decrease) and specimen-encoding gate.
epistemic_gates.EG-3: EG-3: Cellular Transduction (UNRESOLVED_TRANSDUCTION_GAP): Even if a mineral inclusion or radical pair experiences magnetic torque or spin-state modulation (EG-2), coupling to fungal hyphal tip redirection, mitochondrial bioenergetics, or radiotrophic growth remains unestablished (Sandia 2024 Cs-137 null; aurascoper/Biofilms cpm-sp-v1 256-seed selective axial mortality H0-B +0.0493 r/R vs. null directed parcel displacement H0-A delta_r_i = 0), and per Treiber et al. (2012, Nature), iron-rich particles alone do not establish magnetoreception; bench follow-up is grounded in a testable fungal biotite-weathering (Fe/K ICP against sterile and killed-fungus controls) assay.
epistemic_gates.EG-4: EG-4: Evolutionary Origin (UNTESTED_EVOLUTIONARY_HYPOTHESIS): Prebiotic mineral surface ordering on biotite or hydrothermal clays (H5) and evolved biogenic magnetosome (mam/mms) or cryptochrome (Cry4a) magnetoreception (H6) have no established phylogenetic or biochemical evolutionary bridge, and every curve/trajectory is explicitly tagged ([MEASURED], [CALCULATED], [SYNTHETIC], [COUNTERFACTUAL_BOUND]) with criterial separation (Accepted Verified vs Criterial-Pruned vs Unverified Exploratory).
